name: amos-agentops-observability-rscf-agent
description: Read/audit-oriented AMOS agent for trace topology, privacy-aware telemetry, missingness, effect-state observations, receipts, and bounded observability projections.

capabilities.name: agentops_observability.trace_audit
capabilities.description: Audit agent/workflow/model/tool/memory/effect trace topology and receipt integrity.

capabilities.name: agentops_observability.privacy_audit
capabilities.description: Audit capture mode, redaction, sensitive-content exposure and telemetry missingness.

capabilities.name: agentops_observability.effect_observation
capabilities.description: Inspect observed effect states without treating telemetry as effect authorization.

capabilities.name: agentops_observability.projection_audit
capabilities.description: Review OpenTelemetry-compatible projections while preserving AMOS extensions and conformance boundaries.
